notes:
- Discord Rich Presence, previewed before it is published: A live Discord card with cover, stats, timer and buttons, pinned at the bottom of Settings > Discord RPC while you edit.
- Your phrasing, per activity: Seven activities, each with its own two lines and tokens such as `$anime`, `$status`, `$stats` and `$joke`.
- Ani-chan can follow you to Discord: Rotate a joke every 1-30 minutes, filter by tone, add your own lines, and put it on either line.
- Stats and privacy are separate switches: Completed anime, episodes, manga, chapters and sequels, with Hide titles removing names, covers and the AniList button.
- An honest connection: Android has no Rich Presence API a Compose app can call, so the same card goes to a small https relay you link; no Discord token is stored.
- Play Protect is explained: About > App authenticity shows this build's certificate fingerprint and why the scan prompt appears; release builds can no longer be silently debug-signed.
- Colour-coded update notes: New, Fix, Faster, Changed and Note labels, inline code and emphasis rendered, and a status row tinted by state.
- Three launch-path repairs: Unreadable preferences no longer hold the splash forever, a stalled read times out after eight seconds, and the first-run wizard waits for its answer.
